'''Surdu''' was a statesman of the [[Black Shred Water clan]]. The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] pilot [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] traced his linage back to Surdu, which to him was an honor that inflated his ego.<ref name="NEGC" />
